[1/2] Fix the two storage durability findings and sync the module version; add failing-first tests for an unreadable ledger, a failed atomic backup, and package metadata

impact_assessment.why: Reforge review found an unreadable ledger could be overwritten and a backup could be destroyed by a crash, and pyproject 0.2.0 disagrees with tally.__version__ 0.1.0
impact_assessment.benefits: A read error leaves the ledger and backup intact; a failed backup replace keeps the previous backup; the importable version matches the package metadata
impact_assessment.risks: contract: storage failure paths change from starting empty to refusing, and .bak gains atomic replacement; dependency: none (stdlib only); concurrency: the lock, read-modify-write order and stale-lock rules are unchanged; state: JSON schema, lock protocol and backup filename are unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: Three failing-first tests pin the new failure paths and the version match; all four project gates run before the commit; the unrelated dirty LICENSE files are not staged

impact_assessment.risks: contract: documentation and legal text only, no code or schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no migration
